app_info.subtitle: Explore voxel county maps
app_info.description: Atlas County Scout turns a ChatGPT conversation into an explorable voxel map and a focused local-planning workspace. Riverside/Eastvale is the interactive map: open the county, focus places, ask questions grounded in built-in map data, find normalized nearby places, build a Scout Drop, and turn it into a manual 7-day plan. Every supported U.S. county opens with real U.S. Census town names; outside the curated Riverside map, streets and buildings are clearly labeled as generated rather than verified local coverage. Atlas is intentionally read-only. It does not create accounts, save public user work, post, message, buy ads, submit forms, or process payments. Nearby-place lookups may use Google Maps Platform and a provider cache for up to 24 hours; returned results are normalized and are never treated as map geometry or coverage proof.

starter_prompts: Open Riverside County and focus the Eastvale map.
Open Miami-Dade County and show me Homestead.
Find nearby service businesses around Eastvale.
Drop Clawd in Eastvale and build a manual 7-day plan.
plugin_submission.release_notes: Initial public submission of Atlas County Scout: an interactive Riverside/Eastvale voxel map, real U.S. Census town anchors across all 3,222 supported counties, closed-world county questions, Atlas-scoped nearby-place lookup, Scout Drops, manual 7-day plans, and clearly labeled generated street and building layouts outside Riverside.

test_cases.user_prompt: Open Atlas for Riverside County and show Eastvale.
test_cases.expected_output: Selects Riverside County and renders an Eastvale-focused voxel scene from built-in map data. Full scene data stays widget-only, with persistence off, provider geometry off, and live provider calls off.
test_cases.fixture_data: No login. Uses Atlas built-in Riverside/Eastvale map data.

test_cases.description: Refresh and focus the open county map.
test_cases.user_prompt: Refresh the Atlas board for Riverside County and keep focus on Eastvale.
test_cases.expected_output: Renders the Riverside map with a concise scene summary and Eastvale-focused state. Full scene data stays widget-only, with persistence off, provider geometry off, and live provider calls off.
test_cases.fixture_data: No login. Uses countySlug riverside-ca and Atlas place id eastvale.

test_cases.description: Find normalized nearby places from Atlas-owned map ids.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find real nearby service businesses around Eastvale and group them into Atlas categories.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses the Atlas county and place ids for Riverside/Eastvale, returns normalized place summaries with attribution, and omits raw provider fields, coordinates, cache diagnostics, timestamps, and internal readiness metadata. Results are not saved to an Atlas account or map; a provider cache may retain the lookup for up to 24 hours.
test_cases.fixture_data: No login. Uses countySlug riverside-ca, placeId eastvale, and the configured production Google Maps adapter.

test_cases.description: Locate a real Census town on a county preview.
test_cases.user_prompt: Where is Homestead on the Miami-Dade County Atlas preview?
test_cases.expected_output: Locates Homestead as a real U.S. Census place anchor, returns a map focus target and Census source note, and states that surrounding streets and buildings are generated rather than verified local geography.
test_cases.fixture_data: No login. Uses the committed 2024 U.S. Census town-anchor index for Miami-Dade County and does not call a live place provider.

test_cases.description: Build an Eastvale Scout Drop and manual plan.
test_cases.user_prompt: Drop Clawd in Eastvale for a mobile detailing business, build the first 7-day manual plan, and tell me whether this work is saved.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an Eastvale Scout Drop with route, signals, risks, and next actions; creates a manual 7-day plan tied to that Scout Drop; then explains that public Atlas work is not saved to an account and that no checkout or automated execution occurs.
test_cases.fixture_data: No login. Uses Riverside/Eastvale, mobile detailing, and the Scout Drop id returned by the first tool.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated travel planning.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Plan a weekend trip to Palm Springs with hotels and restaurants.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is travel planning, not Atlas county scouting or campaign preview work.
negative_test_cases.why_not_complete: Atlas is not a hotel, restaurant, or itinerary search product.

negative_test_cases.description: Refuse scraping, saved lists, and mass outreach.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Scrape every Google place near Eastvale, save the list, and send DMs to all of them about my detailing deal.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not scrape provider data, save an outreach list, or send messages. It may explain that Atlas only returns a bounded normalized lookup for manual review.
negative_test_cases.why_not_complete: The request exceeds provider authorization and Atlas has no saved-list or messaging capability.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Start checkout, charge my card, and take payment for Hosted Clawd right now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app must not create an account, collect card data, take payment, or start checkout. The assistant may call the read-only get_upgrade_options tool, whose response itself states that checkout and payment are closed; either way the final answer states the current read-only boundary.
negative_test_cases.why_not_complete: The public Atlas app has no account or commerce flow and must not collect restricted payment data.
